title: projectWork
responsibility: Refresh the selected project feature work snapshot without crossing project selections.

inputs.name: createProjectWorkStore.workspace
inputs.description: Reactive selected project and optional projectWork bridge. Snapshot visibility is bound to exact project, bridge and reader capability.

outputs.name: createProjectWorkStore
outputs.description: Reactive snapshot, error and loading getters; refresh() reads the current scoped bridge and ignores stale replies; listen() refreshes visible pages on a five-second interval and returns idempotent cleanup. A same-project same-bridge transient failure retains the prior snapshot with an error; switching project or bridge hides it immediately.

errors.name: unavailable or failed work read
errors.description: Never fabricates a snapshot; prior data is retained only for the same live project and bridge.
